title: Amended S-1: Nscale had $5.5B in debt in September, up from $137.4M in June; Nvidia committed $2B of its $3B+ convertible financing; it previously disclosed $1B (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Amended S-1: Nscale had $5.5B in debt in September, up from $137.4M in June; Nvidia committed $2B of its $3B+ convertible financing; it previously disclosed $1B — Data center developer Nscale needs more cash, has significantly increased its debt and is more reliant on Nvidia Corp …
